about_the_game:
This is an unconventional post-apocalyptic survival sandbox game. Players will abandon endless combat and instead immerse themselves in a gritty, authentic apocalypse survival experience.

​

Through a first-person perspective, players will gather resources, craft tools, construct fortified bases, and explore surrounding areas to scavenge anything that aids survival.

​Upcoming Features & Gameplay:​​

  • ​Faction Diplomacy & Conflict:​​ Negotiate with factions through bartering and alliances, or rally others to oppose them. The world’s political landscape will dynamically shift based on player decisions.

  • ​Survivor Rescue & Colony Building:​​ Rescue survivors scattered across the wasteland and establish thriving settlements for them. As trust grows, survivors may join your crew, bolstering your forces to dominate the wasteland.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 - 4GB or Radeon RX 470 - 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • OS: 64 bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700k or AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 - 6GB or AMD Radeon 5700 XT - 8GB
